final:
Subject: Your Sigma 18-35 deposit

Hi Aoife,

Thank you for returning the Sigma 18-35. I wanted to write personally about your $600 deposit, because I know a deduction is never what anyone hopes to see.

When we checked the lens, we found a scratch on the front element. We've deducted $160 from your deposit to cover it. We believe this is fair, as it's damage beyond normal wear and tear. I also understand it's frustrating to hear, especially if you weren't aware of it happening. These things can easily occur in the middle of a shoot.

If it would help, I'm happy to send you photos of the scratch so you can see exactly what we found.

I'd also like to offer something. If you prefer, we can lower the deduction to $100 and refund the $60 difference to you, as a gesture of goodwill.

How would you like to proceed? Just let me know, and I'll take care of it right away.

Thanks again for renting from us, and for your understanding.

Warm regards,
[Your name]
[Company name]
